messages:
Aisha (Revenue Ops): Quick heads-up — Ben forwarded a request from AtlasEdge for a short-term pricing concession on a Dedicated commitment. TL;DR: 12mo commit, 3 P40 equiv, asking for a 22% unit discount in month 1-3 to help with onboarding costs. Need finance OK + legal note.
Ben (Sales): Yep — AtlasEdge says they’ll sign a 12mo PO if we do a 22% promo for Q1 of the contract. ARR impact is mostly in year 1; they expect usage to ramp. They want Net45 and early-bird credits.
Marcus (Finance): Can you drop the proposed P&L impact? Need MRR delta and payback table to greenlight. Also any precedent?
Ben (Sales): Precedent: gave 15% to Helix last year for dedicated; that had an onboarding credit but no Net45. Proposal below:
```
Line items:
- Dedicated compute (3x P40 equiv): $45,000/mo list
- Standard discount: 0%
- Promo onboarding credit (months 1-3): 22% off compute => -$29,700 total over 3 mo
- Contract length: 12 months
- Billing: Net45 requested
```
Leah (Customer Success): AtlasEdge is high-touch — engineering will need 2 weeks of priority on-call and an extra model conversion sprint. The onboarding credit helps them justify the ramp to their leadership.
Aisha (Revenue Ops): Comp modeling: if we accept 22% for months 1-3, extended ARR ~ $540k list -> trimmed to ~ $520k first-year net (estimating ramp). I can share a spreadsheet if finance wants precise rows.
Priya (CFO): Not comfortable with Net45 for a new mid-market account on Dedicated. We can do Net30 and a 10% promo instead of 22%. What’s the minimum Ben needs to close?
Ben (Sales): Net30 is doable, but 10% won't be enough for their procurement team. They asked execs to validate at 20%+. The risk is losing the deal; they have alternatives.
Marcus (Finance): Okay. Two paths: 1) Approve 20% onboarding promo (months 1-3), Net30, and require a billing security deposit equivalent to 1 month list; or 2) 10% promo and Net30 with no deposit. Recommend path 1 only if Legal signs a limited concession addendum.
LegalBot: Quick flag — any concession >15% requires a signed concession addendum, clause for recoverability if usage drops >40% in first 90d. Also need approval from revenue ops for recognition.
Aisha (Revenue Ops): I can draft the concession addendum with the recovery clause. Suggest clause: "If actual monthly consumption falls below 60% of projected consumption for any 30d window in the first 90d, Redwood may invoice the shortfall at list rates and the customer agrees to pay within Net30."
Priya (CFO): That recovery clause is reasonable. Marcus, Aisha — run numbers with the deposit and 20% promo. If the net present value hit is < $25k and Legal signs addendum, I will sign off.
Ben (Sales): Will do. If we can get a quick verbal nod, I'll push for LOI today. If Marcus/Aisha can post the final numbers here by EOD, I can present to the customer. :pray:
Marcus (Finance): I'll post the quick calc by 5pm PT.
Leah (Customer Success): Heads-up — engineering calendar already has a placeholder 2-week onboarding window starting Apr 10 if we close.
Aisha (Revenue Ops): Noted. I'll draft the addendum and share before 4pm.
Ben (Sales): Thanks all. tagging @Priya for final once numbers are in. :thumbsup:
Priya (CFO): Thanks. If numbers meet the threshold, approve subject to addendum and Net30.
